annotations.title: Get the read-only SQL that snapshots a live Supabase database for Deadbolt

description: Use when you need to check a live Supabase project rather than migration files: returns a read-only SQL query that reads table RLS settings, grants for anon and authenticated, policies, SECURITY DEFINER functions and storage buckets (never row data) and returns one JSON value. Run it with the user's Supabase SQL Editor or a Supabase MCP execute_sql tool, then pass the JSON to deadbolt_check_supabase_access.
name: deadbolt_catalog_query
title: Get the read-only SQL that snapshots a live Supabase database for Deadbolt
